name: Color Sensor

maxRange.label: Max range (m)
maxRange.desc: How far down the beam a target is still read. The beam is cast along local +Z, so aim the sensor by rotating it.

showBeam.label: Show beam
showBeam.desc: Draw the beam line in the viewport. A viewing aid only - hiding it does not change what the sensor reads.

colors.label: Colors
colors.desc: The colours this sensor tells apart. The colour code is the position in this list: 1 for the first, 2 for the second, and so on.

tolerance.label: Match tolerance
tolerance.desc: How far a tint may be from a listed colour and still match, in steps of 0 to 255 on each of red, green and blue. 0 matches only the exact colour. When two listed colours are within range, the closer one wins.

colorTag.label: Color code tag
colorTag.desc: Where the detected colour code is published: the position of the matched colour in Colors (1 = the first), or 0. It reads 0 both when nothing is in range and when no listed colour matches, so pair it with a presence sensor if the difference matters.
